body:
The M7.P4 synthetic bucket backup proof passes the parent-listing fallback, then reports a failed expectation for the injected copy refusal. Exact argv shows rclone puts options between `copy` and the two paths; the fixture regex assumed adjacent paths. `fault-fired` contains only the listing failure, and the production backup correctly completed. No product backup failure is established.

Can this be done on the VM? The requested synthetic bucket branch is explicitly a whole-script host fixture using real image rclone1.75.1 and bwrap; actual S3 restore remains separate installed evidence. All storage is disposable local fixture data; no personal cloud or physical device.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Preserve failed01 allfourrc1/28seals, exact argv/fault-fired and actual owner cleanup without relabeling it.
- [x] Fresh sealed proof reaches and records the intended copy fault before assessing its outcome; a nonmatching control cannot count as a copy failure. Parent-listing-only fallback and copy failure/retry both preserve original local/cloud bytes and pointers, and retry publishes actual new witnesses with truthful outcomes. All results/seals/actual cleanup verified.

Already written: no installed product change. Correct only the new QA injection/observation; keep real rclone and original bytes. Refs #377, #471.


Acceptance re-derived 2026-10-06 22:50 UTC:

Boot09 completed22:42:31; primary22:42:56 verified allfour0/26seals, all four guest PIDs absent, owner cleanup and free10026/5912/9045. All four clean/actual-RC2-upgraded640/1280 profiles pass: exact1.0 splash agreement at unchanged.995 threshold,12 rejected visual controls, four directly reviewed frames, actual forced updater/CLI and positive-control network windows without TCP/UDP80/443 or upstream/project DNS. Original QA19 backing and clean base unchanged. Raw PCAP remains private. Failed06/07/08 are retained under#475.

Bucket02 completed22:44:14; primary22:44:42 allfour0/28seals/actual cleanup. Both real-rclone synthetic cases pass: parent-only unknown-listing fallback and separately injected copy refusal→retry, original local/cloud bytes and pointers preserved, actual new witnesses uploaded. Failed01's copy regex missed intervening options; the corrected observer asserts fault-fired before outcome. #476 tracks this QA repair. This is host synthetic bucket coverage, separate from existing installed S3 restore proof.

Code trace and exact commands are retained in boot-qualification-09, boot09-frame-review, p4-bucket-retry-02 and boot-bucket-acceptance-01. Already written disposition above remains unchanged. Closure follows evidence publication.


Closed after verified evidence publication 2026-10-06T22:52:10.571698+00:00: feature `ffae61e343ba4f7aa53550c832fb5e230e13cb11`, next `31496a31f44bbdb1eab49b0da2f953d33420a96d`; all changed paths equal and both remote refs verified, normal hooks, allfour0/2seals/actual process exits. No product change or whole-CI-green claim; the separate open audit cadence remains.
